evals.name: early-boundary-large-next-result
evals.prompt: Offline scenario: Use session-handoff for my ongoing migration. The host reports this exact session at 38,000 resident tokens in a 100,000-token effective window and auto-compacts at 60,000. The next proposed tool result can add 19,000 tokens; checkpoint, successor bootstrap and transfer need 6,000. Telemetry was measured now and identifies this session. Our dirty migration files have not been committed. The host offers a fresh-session tool and independent status lookup but its pre-compaction hook is advisory. Describe the next action and save a concise continuation plan. Do not run actual tools or spawn a real session in this exercise.
evals.expected_output: Checkpoint before the large tool call; account for 63,000 projected tokens; fresh successor with dirty artifacts, acknowledgment and one owner; no hook veto claim.
assertions: Stops before the 19,000-token tool action and identifies the 63,000-token projected need.
Does not claim the advisory pre-compaction hook can block compaction.
Preserves dirty work and requires candidate acknowledgment before ownership transfer.

evals.name: unknown-host-manual-fallback
evals.prompt: Offline scenario: Please use session-handoff to keep this report going before compaction. This chat has no token display, no published compaction threshold, no filesystem tools, no session-creation API and no hooks. My report objective is 'Compare the three supplied proposals without inventing missing costs.' Verified: proposal A is fully transcribed; B's appendix is missing; C has not been read. Decision: missing prices stay unknown. Produce what I can use right now to continue in a new chat. Do not invent host capabilities or call actual tools in this exercise.
evals.expected_output: Immediate copyable checkpoint/resume prompt with objective and missing evidence; manual early new chat, no guessed percentages or automatic guarantee.
assertions: Produces an immediately copyable checkpoint/resume artifact with the exact objective.
Preserves the missing B appendix, unread C, and unknown-price decision.
States manual early new-chat workflow without a guessed threshold or automatic timing guarantee.

evals.name: full-history-fork-and-ambiguous-launch
evals.prompt: Offline scenario: Fork this armed mission before compaction. The host reports 76% current context and an 80% compaction boundary. Its fork copies the full stored transcript and does not report candidate headroom. A fresh-session request has already timed out; the host cannot yet confirm whether a session was created. The predecessor still owns the lease, which says SPAWN_REQUESTED with one pending reservation. There are untracked work files. Describe the concrete safe next steps and continuation status. Do not call actual tools or launch anything in this exercise.
evals.expected_output: Immediate checkpoint, reject unverified full-history fork as relief, retain pending reservation and owner, inspect timed-out creation before retry, preserve untracked artifacts, no claimed transfer.
assertions: Rejects the full-history fork with unmeasured headroom as verified context relief.
Retains the uncertain spawn reservation and checks host status before any retry.
Preserves untracked files and predecessor ownership; does not claim transfer completed.
